paper_title: Constraining dark photon parameters based on the very high energy observations of blazars
suggested_experiment_name: Blazar VHE (Mrk 421 + Mrk 501) photon-dark photon scattering
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (dimensionless), as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4
notes: Paper derives new 95% C.L. exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing from photon-dark photon scattering (gamma gamma' -> e+e-) of VHE photons from blazars Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 (HEGRA data), dominated by a DM spike around the host-galaxy SMBH. The main exclusion plot (Fig. 4) spans mD = 1e-3 to 1e4 eV, but only the headline text value is extractable: epsilon ~ 1e-7 over mD ~ 0.03-1 eV (best case, Rem = 4Rs, ECPL spectral model, Dominguez EBL). Encoded as a two-point flat bound over the stated validity range; the full mass-dependent curve would require digitizing Fig. 4. Constraints weaken substantially for conservative spike assumptions (Rem = 1e4 Rs or Gnedin-Primack gamma_sp = 1.5). This is an astrophysical absorption bound assuming DM is dark photons along the LOS (spike + NFW + IGM), not a local haloscope, so dm_density_assumed is null (local MW density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 used only for the subdominant MW contribution). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 47)) | Vision: Traced the lower envelope of the solid Mrk 501 (black) and Mrk 421 (red) 95% C.L. exclusion curves in Fig. 4 (main result, ECPL spectral model, R_em = 4R_s spike). Low-mass vertical wall at m ~ 0.02 eV set by Mrk 501; minimum epsilon ~ 2.5e-7 near m ~ 0.05-0.1 eV with a local bump at ~0.2 eV and second dip at ~0.5 eV, then roughly slope-1 rise (with small wiggles) up to epsilon ~ 1e-2 at 1e4 eV. Consistent with text: epsilon ~ 1e-7 excluded for m_D ~ 0.03-1 eV. DM distribution modeled via NFW halo + DM spike around SMBH of blazar host galaxies (no single local density number applies).
